KLIC.theme_source: Theme keys assigned from the MEASURED residual correlations in cache/oracle_upside_cluster_study.json (2026-09-09; 42 daily log returns 2026-07-09..2026-09-08, OLS residual vs SPY per name), NOT from a sector taxonomy. Exactly two pairs co-move significantly after removing the market: KLIC~TPC residual r=+0.443 (t=3.08) and PAY~QTWO residual r=+0.440 (t=3.06). LXU and ZVRA co-move significantly with nothing. This MATTERS because size_upside_book's default cluster key reads `theme` first and falls back to `sector`: under the Sharadar SECTOR key, KLIC+PAY+QTWO group as one 'Technology' cluster at 46.53% of equity and the 40% cap would force a trim on a grouping the data says is not a cluster at all (KLIC~QTWO residual r = -0.448, t=-3.13 — they HEDGE each other), while the pair that genuinely co-moves, KLIC~TPC, sits in two different sectors and would never have been capped. Under the evidenced theme key the live weights are ai_capex_buildout 29.16% and bank_biller_saas 35.28% — both under the 40% cap, so nothing needs trimming today, but the cap can now BIND on the right grouping at the rebuild.
